title: What are common problems with cigar cabinet humidifiers?
desc: Common issues include inconsistent humidity levels, unresponsive controls, leaks, unusual noises, or the unit not turning on. If you notice any of these, it's time to get it checked.

title: How do I know if my humidifier needs repair?
desc: If your humidifier shows signs like fluctuating humidity, leaks, or power issues, it’s best to call for professional repair before the problem gets worse.

title: Can I fix my cigar cabinet humidifier myself?
desc: DIY fixes might work temporarily, but professional repair ensures a long-lasting solution and prevents further damage to your cigars

title: How long does it take to repair a cigar cabinet humidifier?
desc: Most repairs can be done quickly, often within 24 hours, so your humidifier will be back in action without delay.
